steps.prompt: Using the ready initial assessment for {{ inputs.feature_context }}, recheck the exact existing specification and convergence evidence. Return status_action run only for an existing Draft specification whose current convergence and completion authority are clear; otherwise skip for an already Complete specification. Unsupported lifecycle state, lost evidence, or an unsettled decision stops before any command with the exact operator question or recovery action. Do not create a specification or change scope.

input.args: SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY={{ inputs.feature_context }} Update only the exact existing specification in place from Status: Draft to Status: Complete, as authorized by this Closeout workflow only when current convergence and completion authority are clear. Preserve every requirement, reviewed decision, and active feature identity. Do not create or renumber a feature, regenerate the specification, change scope, modify the roadmap, or imply verification or acceptance. Return the exact changed path, resulting status, and any blocker. Missing or unsupported state stops without creating files.

SPEC_TARGET={{ inputs.feature_context }} Run a fresh read-only roadmap debrief against the exact existing specification and current attributable implementation delta on every pass, including the first and the pass after correction or implementation. Return the full findings and prerequisite errors in report, exact selected_entry_id, and any exact proposed verification patch in proposed_patch. Do not edit the roadmap. Missing, stale, failed, or untrusted delta must be reported, never treated as verified. Do not infer feature acceptance.

steps.prompt: Classify this fresh debrief report for {{ inputs.feature_context }}: {{ steps.debrief-roadmap.output.report }}. Independently review implementation changes since the prior pass for code defects and relevant validation evidence. Include exact code findings and repository-relative evidence. Review an attributable implementation delta with changed paths and before/after evidence; if that boundary is unavailable, stop with an untrusted-delta recovery. Return exact review findings as a separate workflow-specific result alongside the strict envelope, retaining stable ID, task_id, artifact_location, violated requirement, observed deficiency, and exact correction. Fresh independent assessment must confirm substantive resolution and retain new blocking findings. With no safe eligible correction route, return blocked with a specific task-recording or reopening resumption action. Preserve the exact unanswered product question and never infer an answer; successful commands cannot discharge findings. A code finding may continue only when it is represented by an existing or newly recorded in-scope task that can be made eligible through the existing analysis and eligibility steps; otherwise return blocked with a precise resume_action to record or reopen the task before implementation. Return a validated outcome envelope with state complete, continue, or blocked; stable reason_code; current repository-relative evidence paths and SHA-256 digests; remaining_ids; resolved_ids; and state-dependent routing fields. Complete requires clean current convergence, an existing Complete specification, no material code-review finding, and a trusted debrief supporting either the exact proposed verification patch (reason_code patch-ready) or the already-verified roadmap entry (reason_code already-verified). Continue is limited to routine, safely repairable in-scope findings; select the highest affected next_step_id: reconcile-closeout-specification, reconcile-closeout-plan, reconcile-closeout-tasks, or implement-closeout-eligible-tasks. The first report establishes the finding baseline. Later reports must prove resolution of a prior finding; changed bytes, new tasks, checkboxes, status changes, and successful commands alone do not demonstrate progress. Blocked includes required product, constitutional, authority, material-scope, or ambiguous-recovery decisions, missing prerequisites, failed commands, stale evidence, untrusted delta, or unsafe correction. Preserve the exact question or blocker and stable resume_action without taking the consequential action. The controller validates this assessment and checks progress and the correction cap before entering the waterfall. Routing fields are state-dependent. For `complete`, omit `next_step_id`, `gate_step_id`, and `resume_action`; for `continue`, include only `next_step_id` targeting a declared loop-body step; for `blocked`, include only a stable `resume_action`. Never include a routing field for `complete`. Both `reason_code` and `resume_action` must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` (lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens; never use underscores or spaces).

continue.prompt: Prepare the shared correction waterfall for {{ inputs.feature_context }} from the current validated assess-closeout-debrief outcome and fresh debrief report. For next_step_id reconcile-closeout-specification, set spec_action, plan_action, and task_action to run. For reconcile-closeout-plan, skip specification and run plan and tasks. For reconcile-closeout-tasks, run only tasks. For implement-closeout-eligible-tasks, skip all three artifact stages. Return implementation_args as readable text without template delimiters, preserving exact review findings verbatim and their eligible task mapping, plus those action fields and specification_args, plan_args, and task_args containing exact findings and required downstream reconciliation. Include explicit SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY equal to the existing selected target in specification_args; do not create or renumber a feature. Preserve reviewed intent, lifecycle state, task IDs, completion markers, and completed work. Missing evidence, unsupported routes, or a product, constitutional, authority, material-scope, or ambiguous-recovery decision stops before mutation with the exact operator question and stable recovery action. Do not invoke another workflow.

input.args: Run fresh read-only analysis of the current specification, plan, and tasks for {{ inputs.feature_context }} after the shared waterfall, including implementation-only routes. Return full findings and prerequisite errors in report. Do not modify artifacts or implement work. Missing, failed, or stale analysis cannot authorize implementation.

continue.prompt: Assess this fresh analyzer report: {{ steps.analyze-closeout-artifacts.output.report }} against current tasks for {{ inputs.feature_context }}. Return a validated outcome envelope with state complete, continue, or blocked, stable reason_code, current repository-relative evidence paths and SHA-256 digests, remaining_ids, resolved_ids, and state-dependent routing fields. Continue only when analysis is clean, dependent artifacts agree, and specific in-scope unfinished tasks are eligible; set next_step_id to implement-closeout-eligible-tasks and remaining_ids to their exact IDs. Complete means no eligible implementation work, not feature closeout. Blocked includes unresolved analysis, stale or missing output, failed prerequisites, uncertain eligibility, or required operator input; preserve the exact question or blocker and stable resume_action. A blocked result stops before implementation and any further debrief. Command success and checkbox claims alone are insufficient. Routing fields are state-dependent. For `complete`, omit `next_step_id`, `gate_step_id`, and `resume_action`; for `continue`, include only `next_step_id` targeting a declared loop-body step; for `blocked`, include only a stable `resume_action`. Never include a routing field for `complete`. Both `reason_code` and `resume_action` must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` (lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens; never use underscores or spaces).

input.args: Use these exact review findings {{ steps.prepare-closeout-flowback.output.implementation_args }}. Implement only the exact fresh analyzed eligible tasks for {{ inputs.feature_context }} listed in {{ steps.assess-closeout-task-eligibility.output.remaining_ids }} to resolve the current routine in-scope debrief findings. Preserve reviewed scope, task history, and completed work. Complete all eligible work in that set or stop for a concrete blocker or required operator input. Return completed and remaining IDs, validation evidence, changed paths, and any blocker or question in report. Do not re-specify, re-plan, re-task, invoke another workflow, update the roadmap, integrate Git, or claim acceptance.
